name: @djgrant/chatgpt/chat
description: Reads the conversation in the open logged-out chatgpt.com tab: all user and assistant messages, plus the latest response. Never reloads the tab — a reload would erase a logged-out chat. An empty page returns an empty transcript. See @djgrant/chatgpt/send and @djgrant/chatgpt/clear.

resolve.prompt: This is a chatgpt.com conversation page. Return {turns, response}. turns is an array of {role, text} in reading order, where role is 'user' for messages under 'You said:' and 'assistant' for messages under 'ChatGPT said:'. response is the text of the last assistant turn, or null when there is none. If no conversation is visible, return {turns: [], response: null}.
